referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Zuni Café website in San Francisco, California uses a full-bleed evening exterior photograph above a dark editorial canvas. Navigation is short anchor navigation to menus, reservations and location. Its page moves through venue photograph, seasonal announcement, reservation details, restaurant story, menu directory, social image band, hours and location, with plain text menu categories instead of identical food cards. restaurant exterior and dining photographs as selective editorial punctuation. Transferable mechanics are dark editorial chapters, menu directory, hours and location ledger. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
